title: Privacy and cookies
officer: Person in charge of the protection of personal information
noContact: The contact details of the person in charge of the protection of personal information are not configured yet.
intro: This page explains, in plain terms, what information the Disponibilités application collects, why, who can see it and what your rights are. It is based on Quebec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, as modernized by Law 25.

summary.title: In short
summary.cookie: The application uses a single cookie, strictly necessary for it to work. It is only created when you open the link of an occasion someone shared with you (or link a device): simply visiting the home page creates none.
summary.noTracking: No advertising, analytics, tracking or social media cookies.
summary.noSale: Your information is never sold, rented or disclosed for commercial purposes.
summary.noAccount: No account or password: only your name is required, your email is optional.

storage.title: Cookies and storage in your browser
storage.name: Name

cookie.use: Recognize your browser so you find your occasions and availabilities again, without an account or password. It contains a random identifier, nothing else. Created when you open an invitation link or link a device.
cookie.duration: Renewed on every visit (browsers limit it to about 400 days without a visit)

theme.use: Remember the chosen theme (light, dark or the device's). Stays on your device.
theme.duration: Until you change it or clear the site's data

lang.use: Remember the chosen language (French or English). Stays on your device.

orgFilter.use: Remember the organization filter of “My occasions”. Stays on your device.

storage.noBanner: Since these items are necessary for the service you request or only remember your preferences, no consent banner is shown. The application uses no technology that can locate or profile you. Clearing this site's cookies disconnects you from your identity: use “Link a phone” beforehand if you want to keep it on another device.

collected.title: Information collected
collected.identity: Your name (required) and your email (optional), entered by you.
collected.slots: Your availability time slots and the occasions you take part in.
collected.created: The occasions and organizations you create (title, description, days, hours, logo).
collected.technical: Technical information: the cookie's identifier, the date of creation and of the last visit. The application does not keep your IP address.

why.title: Why
why.text: Only to run the service: show everyone's availabilities, find common times, manage guests and organizations, and link your devices. It is used for nothing else.

who.title: Who can see your information
who.participants: The other participants of an occasion see your name, your email if you provided it, and your availability time slots for that occasion. Anyone who receives an occasion's link can join it.
who.organizations: The owners and administrators of an organization see the list of its members (name and email).

hosting.title: Hosting and service provider
hosting.text: The application is hosted on a server run by the service operator. To publish it on the Internet, traffic goes through Cloudflare (a company based in the United States), which provides the secure connection (HTTPS). For this purpose, Cloudflare processes technical connection data, such as your IP address, without it being stored in the application.

retention.title: Retention
retention.text: Your information is kept as long as you use the service. When a guest is removed from an occasion, their availability time slots for that occasion are deleted. You can ask at any time for your information to be deleted (see below). Device linking codes expire after 10 minutes.

security.title: Security
security.text: Encrypted connection (HTTPS), cookie inaccessible to scripts (HttpOnly), linking codes stored as a hash and valid only once, isolated servers with minimal rights.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.correct: view and correct your name and email (your profile menu, top right);
rights.access: request access to all the information about you, or have it communicated to you in a structured, commonly used technological format;
rights.delete: request its deletion or withdraw your consent;
rights.complaintLink: Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec
rights.write: To exercise these rights or for any question, write to the person in charge:

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: This page may be updated; the date at the top shows the latest version.
